[{"op": "add", "path": "/projectName", "value": "Customer Portal Migration"}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/owners", "value": [{"ownerId": "OWN-1", "name": "Maya Chen", "capacityHours": 32}]}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/owners/-", "value": {"ownerId": "OWN-2", "name": "Leo Martinez", "capacityHours": 28}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/owners/-", "value": {"ownerId": "OWN-3", "name": "Priya Nair", "capacityHours": 30}}]
Maya should handle discovery workshop prep, and that should take 6 hours.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks", "value": [{"taskName": "Discovery workshop prep", "ownerId": "OWN-1", "effortHours": 6}]}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "API inventory", "ownerId": "OWN-2", "effortHours": 9}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "SSO configuration review", "ownerId": "OWN-2", "effortHours": 7}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Redirect testing plan", "ownerId": "OWN-3", "effortHours": 6}}]
Maya should also own the launch communications outline, with 4 hours planned for it.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Launch communications outline", "ownerId": "OWN-1", "effortHours": 4}}]
Leo can take the browser compatibility checklist too, and that should be 5 hours.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Browser compatibility checklist", "ownerId": "OWN-2", "effortHours": 5}}]
Have Priya own the analytics tagging review, and estimate it at 7 hours.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Analytics tagging review", "ownerId": "OWN-3", "effortHours": 7}}]
Maya should take the stakeholder sign-off packet, and let's budget 8 hours for that.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Stakeholder sign-off packet", "ownerId": "OWN-1", "effortHours": 8}}]
Give Leo the cutover runbook draft, and set that at 6 hours.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Cutover runbook draft", "ownerId": "OWN-2", "effortHours": 6}}]
Priya should also take the UAT scenario cleanup, and that one is 5 hours.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "UAT scenario cleanup", "ownerId": "OWN-3", "effortHours": 5}}]
Maya can take the accessibility smoke test notes too, and that should only be 3 hours.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/tasks/-", "value": {"taskName": "Accessibility smoke test notes", "ownerId": "OWN-1", "effortHours": 3}}]
Now total up Maya’s planned work against her availability.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/ownerWorkloads", "value": [{"ownerId": "OWN-1", "totalEffortHours": 26, "capacityCheck": "within capacity by 6 hours"}]}]
Do the same availability check for Leo.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/ownerWorkloads/-", "value": {"ownerId": "OWN-2", "totalEffortHours": 27, "capacityCheck": "within capacity by 1 hour"}}]
Please total Priya’s planned work against her availability too.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/ownerWorkloads/-", "value": {"ownerId": "OWN-3", "totalEffortHours": 26, "capacityCheck": "within capacity by 4 hours"}}]
Set the plan to run from April 7 through April 18, using Eastern time.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/schedule", "value": {"startDate": "2025-04-07", "endDate": "2025-04-18", "timezone": "America/New_York"}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/milestones", "value": [{"name": "Kickoff", "date": "2025-04-07", "status": "confirmed"}]}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/milestones/-", "value": {"name": "Content freeze", "date": "2025-04-11", "status": "planned"}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/milestones/-", "value": {"name": "UAT readiness", "date": "2025-04-16", "status": "planned"}}]
Add the launch checkpoint for April 18, and mark it as planned.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/milestones/-", "value": {"name": "Launch checkpoint", "date": "2025-04-18", "status": "planned"}}]
Include Jordan from Acme as the main client contact, and note that they’re the sponsor.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/stakeholders", "value": [{"name": "Jordan Blake", "organization": "Acme Retail", "role": "Sponsor"}]}]
Add Nina from Acme as the operations contact, with that role noted.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/stakeholders/-", "value": {"name": "Nina Patel", "organization": "Acme Retail", "role": "Operations contact"}}]
Capture a dependency on the identity provider team, with the SSO test account access needed by April 9.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/dependencies", "value": [{"description": "SSO test account access", "ownerGroup": "Identity Provider Team", "neededBy": "2025-04-09"}]}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/dependencies/-", "value": {"description": "Analytics export sample", "ownerGroup": "Data Warehouse Team", "neededBy": "2025-04-10"}}]
Add a risk about late redirect validation causing launch churn, with a medium likelihood and high impact.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/risks", "value": [{"description": "Late redirect validation could cause launch churn", "likelihood": "medium", "impact": "high"}]}]
Capture another risk: browser issues may show up late, with low likelihood but medium impact.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/risks/-", "value": {"description": "Browser issues may appear late in testing", "likelihood": "low", "impact": "medium"}}]
Add a weekly status update plan: send it every Friday through Slack.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/communications", "value": {"cadence": "weekly", "day": "Friday", "channel": "Slack"}}]
Note that Jordan needs to approve the final go/no-go by April 17 over email.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/approval", "value": {"approver": "Jordan Blake", "dueDate": "2025-04-17", "method": "email"}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/rolloutTarget", "value": {"environment": "production", "system": "Acme customer portal", "region": "us-east-1"}}]

conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a task list where each task has an owner and an effort estimate, with a per-owner workload aggregating each owner's tasks and a capacity check derived from a stated capacity. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a project plan would carry that do not depend on who owns each task, and vary their number and the number of tasks and owners from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Reassign one task from its current owner to a different specific owner.
cascade_pattern: Reassigning a task moves its effort from the old owner's workload to the new owner's, re-sums both, and re-evaluates each owner's capacity check against the stated capacity. Other tasks and owners stay. This is determined because the efforts and capacities are stated.
